## Source-only P2 correction

Pushed clean head `29659099e33da9bead3aad2414f8f3965efafc27` (`fix(speedtest-tracker): reject incomplete completed history`). Delta from reviewed `393ea924`: only `internal/apps/speedtesttracker/homarr.go`, two lines replaced; no fixture, documentation, credential guard, registry or common changes.

Confirmed the exact Homarr image-source [SpeedHistoryChart](https://github.com/homarr-labs/homarr/blob/3d4150e59f600876b7e308f857b2f21572b75348/packages/widgets/src/speedtest-tracker/recent-results.tsx) maps missing/null upload to zero. Removed the `Measured()` bypass: every completed history entry must now pass `conversionCurrent()`, which requires present nonnegative ping, raw download/upload byte rates and integral bit-rate fields with matching rounded byte-to-bit conversions. Missing/null pointers fail; explicit numeric zero remains present and passes when conversions agree. No zero is invented and no incomplete completed entry is skipped. The error names missing fields/conversions and the Setup retry command.

Queued/failed/in-progress handling, latest-result identity/status checks, timestamps/order/window behavior and all ownership/secret/pending guards are unchanged. App history validation runs before any Homarr mutation.

Existing focused tests and full local gate passed: empty gofmt output, build, both vet gates, full tests, race on TUI/Activity/Speedtest Tracker/Homarr, installer shell syntax and diff check. No new tests/files/comments/dependencies, Docker/browser/provider/external measurement/runtime or paid review calls.

Still draft: fresh independent final source axes and eventual reconciled-head review after reference ownership freeze; reference-owned registration; actual credential issuance/capture/scope/recovery; rootless readiness; separately bounded lawful bandwidth/terms approval; native rendered data/timezones/recent-chart behavior; full install/retry/restart/credential/removal lifecycle acceptance. No merge or functional-performance acceptance claimed.

Both independent fresh SOURCE-stage review axes pass with zero findings at 29659099e33da9bead3aad2414f8f3965efafc27, fixed base d956824f3758e26bb9cdfc262e229eaf67ef187c. Spec independently confirmed the completed-history missing/null-field P2 is resolved while explicit numeric zeros and matching byte-to-bit conversions remain valid. Standards found no regression across the full leaf diff or token ownership/pending/private-capture contracts. Read-only reviews only; no new tests/runtime or external measurement. Keep draft/unmerged: final reference-owned registration/ownership freeze, actual issuance/effective scope/rootless, lawful separately approved measurement, rendered/timezone and lifecycle acceptance remain pending. Source review is not full #296 acceptance.
